primitiveBudget: ten generated hinged shutters, three-state proximity reverses, three irregular rings per remote absence, and four liftable departure agreements
renderer: deterministic p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D shutter wall with negative absence forms
memoryRule: one or two noticed shutters remain geometry-neutral; three distinct shutters commit only on departure, returning the visited wall exact while producing a remote absence; four absences compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch moves across three distinct shutters and leaves; Enter or Space notices focused shutters and commits the third; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: Canvas contour constellation, WebGL wrong volume, and DOM wrong sentence -> p5.js Canvas 2D wall of hinged shutters and remote negative absences
compositionRupture: broken orbit, oblique solid cluster, and scattered sentence -> staggered wall with no privileged centre and absences in its gaps
encounterRupture: discrete attention quorum, signed scan reversal, and press-and-cross -> continuous proximity visit whose causal event is departure
temporalRupture: invented centre, delayed depth error, and retained wrong word -> local reverse opens temporarily, then closes while a remote absence accumulates after leaving
mediumRupture: contour loops, WebGL boxes, and DOM text -> Canvas 2D paper planes, folds, cutouts, and irregular negative rings
changedRule: Presence is noticed where the visitor approaches but is not stored there. Only leaving after three distinct shutters produces an absent form elsewhere, while the visited shutters return exactly.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a staggered wall of ten irregular shutters. A valid visit reveals local backs during approach, then closes the visited shutters and creates a materially drawn remote absence after departure; four absences persist.
falsifier: Delete if incomplete or one-site visits commit, if visited shutters deform, if the remote absence is only a colour/readout change, if every departure shares one form, if later absences reset, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v044 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish departure agreement from v041-v043 or if the leave event is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
